newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fire breaks out in Jakarta housing complex.
newsitem.headline: Fire breaks out in Jakarta housing complex.

text.p: A fire broke out on Monday in a housing complex in the heart of the city, fire brigade officials said.
They said they had no further details and that fire engines had been rushed to the spot but added the fire did not appear to be linked to campaign violence in the city over the weekend.
A column of black smoke from the blaze in the Tengsin area near the central business district of the city could be seen from many parts of the capital.
The area mainly comprises privately-owned single-storey houses.
